payload.title: File:Phosphatotitan TD.png
payload.description_html: Phosphatotitan is a titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur from what is now Morocco. It is most closely related to South American titanosaurs, indicating Late Cretaceous titanosaur diversity in the Southern Hemisphere may be underestimated. Smaller than its South American counterparts, Phosphatotitan is estimated at around 4 t in total body mass.
